directory.heading: Customers
directory.lede: Every customer this warehouse delivers to, the addresses their goods are sent to, and what each one is still waiting for.
directory.error: You do not have access to the customers of this warehouse.

active.heading: No customer is recorded yet
active.description: Record a customer together with the address their goods are sent to, and it becomes selectable whenever demand is recorded.

inactive.heading: No customer is inactive
inactive.description: A customer you stop dealing with appears here, still readable and still counting on every order that names it.

detail.empty: Open a customer to see its delivery addresses and what it is waiting for.
detail.error: This customer could not be loaded. Try again.

empty.heading: {{name}} is waiting for nothing
empty.description: Orders this customer is still owed appear here, with the address each one is going to.

reason.inactive: Now inactive — this order keeps going there

address.label: Delivery address
address.inactiveNote: Inactive addresses are not offered here.

record.title: Record a customer
record.lede: A customer is recorded together with the first address their goods are sent to.
record.addressHelp: Written the way you would write it on a label. It is never checked, corrected or looked up.
record.accessNotesHelp: What a driver needs to get in — a gate code, delivery hours, who to ask for.
record.note: This address becomes the customer's main delivery address. You can add more afterwards.

correct.title: Correct the name of {{name}}
correct.lede: A customer name identifies at most one customer in this warehouse.
correct.note: Every order and every frozen purchase draft line that names this customer keeps naming the same customer.

deactivate.title: Deactivate {{name}}?
deactivate.lede: This customer stops being offered when demand is recorded.
deactivate.ordersKeepCounting: Every order that already names it stays readable and keeps counting exactly as before.
deactivate.addressesUnchanged: Its delivery addresses are left exactly as they are.
deactivate.nameStaysTaken: The name stays taken, so no new customer can reuse it.
deactivate.reversible: You can make this customer active again at any time.

addAddress.title: Add a delivery address
addAddress.lede: Another place this customer's goods can be sent to.
addAddress.addressHelp: Written the way you would write it on a label. It is never checked, corrected or looked up.
addAddress.accessNotesHelp: What a driver needs to get in — a gate code, delivery hours, who to ask for.
addAddress.mainLabel: Make this the customer's main delivery address

correctAddress.title: Correct this delivery address
correctAddress.lede: The correction applies wherever this address is used.
correctAddress.accessNotesHelp: Clear this field to remove the access notes.
correctAddress.note: Orders and unfrozen draft lines follow the correction. A frozen line keeps the address the supplier was told.

deactivateAddress.title: Deactivate this delivery address?
deactivateAddress.lede: This address stops being offered wherever a delivery address is chosen.
deactivateAddress.recordsKeepCounting: Every order and every frozen purchase draft line that already names it keeps reading and counting exactly as before.
deactivateAddress.mainMoves: This is the main address, so one of the remaining active addresses becomes the main one instead.
deactivateAddress.reversible: You can offer this address again at any time.

refusal.lastActiveAddress: A customer always keeps at least one active delivery address. Add the replacement address first, then deactivate this one.
refusal.inactiveAddress: An inactive address cannot be the main one. Make it active again first.
refusal.unavailable: This customer is not available. Nothing has changed.
refusal.archived: This warehouse is archived, so nothing here can be changed. Nothing has changed.
refusal.invalid: This could not be saved as it stands. Nothing has changed.
refusal.unknown: This could not be saved. Nothing has changed.
